question: Using only information causally available by each decision date, can a sparse multi-market state distinguish deeper destructive deterioration from ordinary corrections early enough to leave meaningful downside remaining, with acceptably few false alarms?
objective: classification/detection only; no portfolio-return, CAGR, terminal-wealth or drawdown optimization

2015.role: must not automatically be labeled systemic crash; evaluate whether model appropriately assigns elevated but lower state

negative_controls: All other evaluable dates/corrections are false-alarm territory; no hand-picked benign-only controls used for final false-positive accounting.
feature_families: equity drawdown magnitude and speed using trailing-only index/market data
realized-volatility level, acceleration and extreme-move clustering
VIX level/change/rolling percentile where official historical data are available
VVIX level/change/rolling percentile where official historical data are available
breadth and participation from causally timestamped market predictors
OFR FSI total and available category contributions with explicit two-business-day lag
credit/funding series only where historical availability and publication timing can be established
transforms: Levels, 5/20-session changes, acceleration, and rolling 252-session percentiles computed using past data only. No future normalization.
decision_timing: Features through completed session t may first authorize action on next tradable session. OFR observations are additionally lagged by two business days.
model_search: Start with transparent sparse conjunction/score and regularized low-dimensional classifiers. No GA initially. Complexity is penalized. No date/year identifiers.
validation: walk-forward/leave-crisis-out: no crisis being evaluated may determine its thresholds or coefficients
report detection date, sessions from peak, drawdown already incurred, and subsequent downside remaining
report all false-alert episodes and alert-days outside positives
2015 separately assessed as elevated correction rather than forced positive
permutation/search-adjustment audit before any claim of discrimination

success_gate.coverage: meaningful causal distinction in at least 2 of 3 true deep declines under leave-crisis-out
success_gate.economic_information_only: at detection, nontrivial subsequent downside must remain; this is descriptive and not used to fit portfolio returns
success_gate.false_alarms: must be rare enough that a full-exit policy is plausibly usable; exact burden reported, never hidden
success_gate.stability: result must not depend on a single feature or single crisis
